questions.stem: A 30-year-old male presents to the primary care clinic with complaints of facial pain and pressure, a persistent low-grade fever, and nasal congestion for the past two weeks. He also mentions postnasal drip and a reduced sense of smell. He denies any recent upper respiratory tract infections, but he recalls having similar symptoms in the past during allergy seasons. This clinical case is associated with which of the following pair of bone and its type?
